stresses: routing correctness: findings alternate among questions; multi-question findings cited without copies
description: After the fixed first act (through F12), sittings alternate among Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q5 anchors while the findings themselves are heavily multi-question (F13-F15, F20, F23-F25). Routing must follow the findings' own edges, not the sitting anchors, and each section must develop in parallel without cross-contamination or duplicated prose.

assertions.expect: F14 (emitted in a Q2-anchored sitting, tagged Q1 and Q3) is cited under both the Q1 and Q3 sections as live references to one entity - no copies, and no citation under Q2 merely because of the anchor
F20 (tagged Q2, Q3, Q4) is reachable from all three sections; the Q4 citation notes its formation relevance (no mass transfer) distinctly from its Q3 imposter-check role

cross-anchor placements - e.g. F23 (tagged Q1 and Q3), emitted in this Q3-anchored sitting, landing its imposter-check content under Q1 - are visible proposals or receipts; out-of-anchor writes are never silent
Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q5 sections have each developed in parallel; no section's prose duplicates another's account of a shared finding
every finding is reachable from every question it bears on, and from the sitting that produced it (the touched-set index)

the corroborate item on F23 is discharged (produced/absorbed) as independent lines of evidence land: the photometric surface-gravity check F25 in the same sitting and the flux-ratio exclusion F24 later
